name: FTPJCL.JCL
description:
This JCL job transfers a mainframe dataset to a remote server using FTP (File Transfer Protocol). It connects to a remote host at IP address 172.31.21.124 using provided credentials, navigates to a specific remote directory, and uploads a mainframe sequential file as a text file in ASCII format.Key Functionalities:
Establishes an FTP connection to remote server at IP address 172.31.21.124 using credentials (user: carddemousr) to perform file transfer operations.
Sets the transfer mode to ASCII to ensure proper text file encoding during the file upload process.
Navigates to the remote directory "/ftpfolder" on the target server after verifying the current working directory and listing its contents.
Uploads the mainframe dataset 'AWS.M2.CARDEMO.FTP.TEST' to the remote server as a file named "welcome.txt" in the /ftpfolder directory.
Terminates the FTP session gracefully after the file transfer is complete.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The FTP job FTPJCLS is initiated and ready to execute file transfer operations
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The FTP program attempts to connect to the remote server at IP address 172.31.21.124
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: A network connection is successfully established with the remote server at 172.31.21.124, enabling the FTP session to proceed; if the server is unreachable, all subsequent file transfer operations are abandoned and no file is transferred

rules.Rule_Description: Establishes a network connection to the designated remote server as the first step of the Card Demo file transfer process.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A network connection has been successfully established with the remote server at 172.31.21.124
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The FTP session submits username 'carddemousr' and password 'ftpdemo1' to the remote server for authentication
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The user 'carddemousr' is authenticated and granted access to perform file operations on the remote server; if authentication fails, the session is rejected and no file transfer or directory operations are executed

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1 - FTP - User Authentication for Remote Server Access
rules.Rule_Description: Authenticates the FTP session using designated credentials to gain authorized access to the remote server before any file operations are performed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user 'carddemousr' is authenticated and an active FTP session exists on the remote server at 172.31.21.124
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The transfer mode is set to ASCII for the active FTP session
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All subsequent file transfers within this session are performed in ASCII text mode, ensuring the mainframe file's character encoding is automatically converted to a format compatible with the remote server

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1 - FTP - ASCII Transfer Mode Configuration
rules.Rule_Description: Configures the file transfer mode to ASCII (text) to ensure the Card Demo file is correctly encoded when delivered to the non-mainframe remote server.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authenticated FTP session is active with ASCII transfer mode configured on the remote server
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The current working directory is requested from the remote server using the pwd command
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The remote server returns and displays the current working directory path, confirming the session's active location on the remote server prior to directory navigation

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1 - FTP - Remote Server Current Directory Verification
rules.Rule_Description: Verifies and displays the current working directory on the remote server to confirm the session's starting location before navigating to the target folder.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authenticated FTP session is active, ASCII transfer mode is set, and the current working directory has been verified on the remote server
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A directory listing is requested from the current location on the remote server using the dir command
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The remote server returns and displays all files and folders available in the current directory, allowing confirmation that the target folder structure including /ftpfolder is present before proceeding

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1 - FTP - Remote Directory Content Listing
rules.Rule_Description: Lists the contents of the current directory on the remote server to verify the availability of the target folder before navigating to it.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authenticated FTP session is active, ASCII transfer mode is configured, and the remote directory contents have been reviewed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The FTP session navigates to the /ftpfolder directory on the remote server
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The active working directory on the remote server is changed to /ftpfolder, making it the designated destination for the Card Demo Test File upload; if /ftpfolder does not exist, the upload will not be delivered to the correct location

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1 - FTP - Target Delivery Folder Navigation
rules.Rule_Description: Navigates to the designated /ftpfolder directory on the remote server to set the correct destination before uploading the Card Demo Test File.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The FTP session is active, authenticated, ASCII transfer mode is set, and the working directory on the remote server is /ftpfolder
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The mainframe dataset 'AWS.M2.CARDEMO.FTP.TEST' is uploaded to the remote server using the PUT command
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Demo Test File is transferred from the mainframe to the /ftpfolder directory on the remote server and saved with the name 'welcome.txt'; the file content remains unchanged but is delivered in ASCII text format under the new name

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1 - FTP - Card Demo Test File Upload to Remote Server
rules.Rule_Description: Transfers the Card Demo Test File from the mainframe to the /ftpfolder directory on the remote server, renaming it to welcome.txt upon delivery.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Demo Test File 'AWS.M2.CARDEMO.FTP.TEST' has been uploaded to /ftpfolder on the remote server as 'welcome.txt'
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The QUIT command is issued to the active FTP session
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The FTP session is gracefully closed, the connection to the remote server at 172.31.21.124 is terminated, and the file transfer job FTPJCLS is completed

rules.Rule_Description: Gracefully closes the FTP session and terminates the connection to the remote server after the Card Demo Test File transfer is complete.
